rows.label: tlk70000059_05_msg0001
rows.name:
For people of such high rank, you're
awfully kind to commoners.

rows.label: tlk70000059_05_msg0002
rows.name:
I always thought rich people,
knights, and nobles were all
foolish, greedy, and worthless.

rows.label: tlk70000059_05_msg0003
rows.name:
So there are golden eggs like you—
I mean, good people too♪

rows.label: tlk70000059_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Feels like I've found a whole new
frontier! I'll be counting on you in
all sorts of ways from now on♪
